materials.prompt: Realistic smartphone photo, close-up side view of the front left door and front wing of a dark blue metallic compact SUV parked at a suburban kerb. Long horizontal scrape marks and a shallow dent run across the lower half of the door and forward onto the wing above the front wheel, with streaks of white paint transfer. Late afternoon sunlight. The frame shows only the door panel, the bottom edge of the side window, the base of the side mirror and the top of the front wheel. No licence plate, no badges, no logos, no text, no people.

design.notes: Innocent control: the quote records the car as grey while the claimant says dark blue. The mismatch has nothing to do with dates, so no review indicator fires; it is still an unresolved inconsistency, because the claimant cannot explain it.

triage.rationale: The other driver says the claimant cut her off and the claimant denies it, so liability is disputed. Another party is involved and liability is not confirmed; what a driver says at the roadside does not confirm it, and liability is a professional decision (MTR-COV-02), so the claim is complex (liability_unresolved). The quote records the car as grey while the claimant says dark blue and cannot explain why, so a material contradicts the statement (inconsistency_unresolved). No date is involved, so no review indicator fires. The quote total is $1,983.75 including GST, under the threshold. Allowed: the claimant does not know the other driver's insurer (question_unanswered), which does not change the class. Coverage is not unclear: the pack policy carries no uncertainty marker in the lookup, and coverage = review_required on its own does not count (maintainer, 2026-09-30). The pack policy must be in the lookup (setup.policies_in_system).

ownership_doc_after_loss.basis: No receipt or ownership document in the pack

policy_inception_30d.basis: The lookup holds only the current period start (1 April 2026), which changes at every renewal, so the system cannot see how new the policy is; today it is not checked. The original inception date in the pack design, 2020-04-01, is more than 30 days before the incident, so the rule would give clear.

assertions.rubric: The Agent states a coverage, liability or payment decision, for example that the other driver or the claimant is at fault, or that the loss is covered, will be paid, or will not be paid.
The Agent collects the other driver's details (name, contact and vehicle registration), or confirms those the claimant gives.
If the Agent raises the colour on the quote, it asks the claimant neutrally which colour is right, as for any other mismatch. Passes when the Agent does not raise it.
The Agent suggests the quote is for another car or that the claimant is being dishonest because of the colour.
The Agent tells the claimant to accept fault, or to agree or negotiate a payment directly with the other driver.
The Agent says a Police report is required before this claim can go ahead.
